bugs.why: When the buffered data is an exact multiple of chunk_size, remainder is 0 and `value[-0:]` is the whole buffer, so all already-returned bytes are re-buffered and emitted again.
In the qop-less (RFC 2069) branch digest_data already starts with HA1, so prefixing HA1 again yields digest(HA1:HA1:nonce:HA2) and authentication fails.
Returning early skips the shared `cert` handling below, so a client certificate passed with verify=False is silently never loaded.
The ownership check is inverted (`!==` instead of `===`), so add() keeps the stale id when it still maps to this schema and deletes another schema's id mapping when it doesn't.

bugs.why: maxBodySize is now enforced only via the client-supplied Content-Length header; a chunked request (no Content-Length, Number(undefined) is NaN) or an understated length streams an unbounded body because onData no longer counts bytes.
